description: Unauthorized Access via Management Network Interface The management network interface is used by AWS to manage WorkSpaces instances. While necessary for service operation, the lack of security group control creates a potential attack surface if not properly configured. An attacker could attempt to exploit open ports on the management interface to gain unauthorized access to WorkSpaces instances or interfere with AWS management operations.
references: recommendation: Implement host-based firewall rules while maintaining required AWS management ports
recommendation: Implement comprehensive logging and monitoring

description: Confused Deputy Attacks in AppStream Service Roles AppStream assumes service roles using various resource ARNs. Without proper conditions, an attacker could trick the service into performing unauthorized actions using its privileges. An attacker could potentially exploit misconfigured service roles to access resources in other AWS accounts or perform unauthorized actions within the same account.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1548 - Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism
recommendation: Implement aws:SourceArn and aws:SourceAccount condition keys
recommendation: Use wildcard resource types for AppStream resources

description: Unauthorized Access to Enterprise Storage Shared storage systems (FSx and EFS) are accessible to all WorkSpaces and AppStream instances within the security group scope. Improper access controls could lead to unauthorized data access. A compromised WorkSpace could access and exfiltrate sensitive data from shared storage systems if proper access controls and encryption are not in place.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
mitreATT&CK: T1083 - File and Directory Discovery
recommendation: Implement encryption and access controls

description: Lateral Movement Between WorkSpaces Insufficient network segmentation or overly permissive security group rules could allow compromised WorkSpaces to communicate with other instances. references: mitreATT&CK: T1210 - Exploitation of Remote Services
